description:
ARTA is an all-in-one, AI photo generator and picture editor, focused on trendy filters, videos, and visual content. Created for anyone, ready for everything.

ARTA empowers you to make eye-catching visuals and share them without limits. Want a viral selfie, a professional photoshoot, or a ready-to-post video? ARTA gets it done, no design skills or equipment needed. Just pick what you’d like to see, and let the app bring it to life.

Loved by 10+ million active users worldwide. Over 600 million artworks dreamed up and counting. 

With ARTA, you can: 
— Stay on-trend with regularly updated filters, styles, and content formats
— Create visuals that get shared, from any text prompt or reference photo in seconds 
— Transform a single selfie into a full professional photoshoot 
— Produce high-quality videos using leading AI models
— Add, remove, or replace any element in any image 
— Preview new outfits, hairstyles, and makeup looks instantly 
— Generate images, videos, and selfies from one powerful platform 

Here’s how it works:

• MAKE YOUR SELFIES GO VIRAL
New filters land in ARTA every week, inspired by what’s going viral on Instagram and TikTok. Try them on, pick your favorite, and post a selfie that’s built to get attention.

• EDIT YOUR IMAGES EASILY
Swap backgrounds, change outfits, remove objects, or sharpen details—on any image. Select what you want to adjust, and ARTA handles the rest. Works on photos you made in the app or anything from your camera roll.

• TURN PHOTOS INTO PHOTOSHOOTS
One pic is all it takes. Generate realistic portraits, professional headshots, or full digital photoshoots with different styles, outfits, and environments. All done on your phone, zero equipment or post-production required.

• BUILD LIFE-LIKE VIDEOS FROM SCRATCH 
Turn photos or a text prompt into dynamic videos with fluid, realistic motion. Powered by top-tier AI models, ARTA takes the work out of producing standout clips with Hollywood-grade quality. Epic scenes, animated moments, custom content—yours in minutes.

• TRY ON STYLES, OUTFITS, AND MAKEUP 
Preview new looks on yourself—outfits, hairstyles, makeup, full aesthetics—without changing a thing in real life. Create polished, influencer-style photos for social media or personal branding effortlessly.

• GENERATE ART FROM TEXT OR PHOTOS
Describe anything or upload a reference photo, and watch it become a high-definition AI image. Explore dozens of realistic, artistic, and creative styles to produce original visuals for any purpose. A city at dusk, cats at a tea ceremony, or a surreal BBQ on Mars—ARTA crafts it all.

One app, many ways to create. Download ARTA now. 

FAQ

Q: Do I need design skills or special equipment? 
A:  Not at all. ARTA is built for everyone, regardless of skill level. Just bring your creativity and watch the magic happen.

Q: Can I create videos? 
A: Yes. ARTA lets you generate videos using AI models like Veo 3.1, Nano Banana 2, Kling, Pixverse, Runway, and Flux 2.

Q: Can I edit photos I didn’t create in ARTA? 
A: Absolutely. Import any photo from your camera roll and use ARTA’s full editing toolkit.

ARTA PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION

• You can subscribe to get unlimited access to certain app features.
• You can enable a free trial to access the features included in the subscription.
• Subscriptions are billed weekly or annually at the rate selected, depending on the subscription plan.
